newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CITIC Pac seeks HK$8 bln loan - bankers.
newsitem.headline: CITIC Pac seeks HK$8 bln loan - bankers.

text.p: Red chip conglomerate CITIC Pacific Ltd is seeking to raise HK$8.0 billion through a seven-year syndicated loan to help fund its investment in China Light & Power Co Ltd, bankers said on Tuesday.

They said the loan would be used for working capital, and to repay a short-term HK$12.5 billion bridging loan signed in February to help fund its HK$16.25 billion acquisition of 20 percent of China Light.
The HK$12.5 billion bridging loan had a tenor of less than one year and was not syndicated.

CITIC Pacific declined to comment on Tuesday on whether it was seeking to raise such a loan. However, the company said in January that it would fund the China Light investment from bank borrowings and internal resources.
